title: Pan-Seared Seafood Skillet
description: A flavorful and quick seafood skillet dish, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This recipe combines succulent seafood with a rich creamy sauce.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the seafood mix and cook for 2-3 minutes, until lightly browned.
Add the white wine and cook for 1 minute, until the liquid is almost completely reduced.
Stir in the heavy cream and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, until the sauce has thickened slightly.
Season with lemon juice and serve immediately.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley if desired.
